title: A GUI must never trigger collection merely by being loaded or launched
requirement_summary: Loading or launching the GUI must never itself start a collector run; collection requires an explicit operator action, or a mechanism entirely outside the GUI process.

title: QC decisions must be atomic, provenance-bearing, append-only, and race-guarded
requirement_summary: A QC decision must be an atomic, provenance-bearing, append-only record, race-guarded against concurrent double-decisions, and the UI must not present it as committed unless the underlying write actually satisfies that contract. The decision contract applies to the operator decision path wherever it lives — GUI, CLI, or other operator tooling — not only where a GUI control exists (decisions/0005).

title: A resolved QC decision must leave the active queue immediately, via read-side filtering
requirement_summary: A decided item must be excluded from the active queue on the very next render, via a read-side filter against the decision record — never by deleting or mutating the live row.

title: A GUI with a QC queue must expose a 'recently QC'd' view backed by the QC archive
requirement_summary: If a GUI exposes a QC queue, it must also expose an operator-visible resolved/QC-history view sourced from the QC archive; a dedicated route or an inline section both satisfy this.

title: Where a production/experimental maturity tier exists, promotion must be an explicit config change, not a GUI action or an automatic decision
requirement_summary: Where a production/experimental maturity tier exists, promotion to production must be an explicit out-of-band config change — never a GUI button, never automatic from runtime metrics.

title: A bulk 'run all' collector control must exclude non-production collectors by default
requirement_summary: A bulk 'run all collectors' control must exclude experimental/soak/non-promoted collectors by default; only the production/finalized list may run in bulk.

title: Manual collector controls must respect and visibly expose collector lifecycle/authority policy
requirement_summary: Manual collector controls must follow the Clank's lifecycle/authority policy: a collector in EXPERIMENTAL/SOAK state does not become runnable merely because a GUI control exists; if policy permits manual runs, the control must identify the collector as non-production and keep such runs out of production bulk actions; if policy forbids it, no individual control may be exposed.

title: Source operational health must be independently expressible from coverage/output
requirement_summary: Source operational health and coverage/output must be expressible as distinct, separately-labeled dimensions; a legitimately quiet source must not read as unhealthy purely from low output.

title: A run's status must not collapse pipeline stages the backend already distinguishes
requirement_summary: Where the backend preserves materially distinct pipeline-phase outcomes for an individual run — a stage field, an ordered ledger, or per-run, phase-attributable outcome fields (fetch/parse failures, validation outcomes, regression notes) — the primary run surface must not erase that distinction, and must visibly indicate and directly link to the deeper detail. An ordered ledger is sufficient but not required; aggregate or windowed metrics alone do not trigger this.

title: Every ambiguous timestamp must identify both its semantic role and its timezone
requirement_summary: Every timestamp whose meaning could be ambiguous must have its semantic role labeled, and its timezone must be unambiguous — a per-value marker or one clearly stated page-level convention both satisfy this.

title: Where delivery exists, delivery state must be inspectable independently from discovery/review state
requirement_summary: Where a delivery mechanism records its own outcome, that outcome must be independently inspectable from discovery/review state; no dedicated delivery page is required, but collapsing distinct outcomes into one ambiguous boolean is not sufficient.

title: Primary workflow must not imply unobserved health
requirement_summary: A primary operator surface must not present the Clank as healthy, normal, or operational solely from successful content activity when health is not actually represented there; where health is intentionally separated, an obvious path to current health should exist when operational judgement is part of the workflow.

title: News/lead-based Clanks: the QC vocabulary's fourth terminal action marks the item no longer distinct/novel
requirement_summary: A news-family Clank's QC vocabulary must use DUPLICATE as its fourth terminal action (not OUT_OF_STOCK); additional Clank-specific values beyond the fleet-standard four are allowed.

title: News-family Clanks: a live editorial intake/review surface must be reachable directly or via one obvious action
requirement_summary: A news-family Clank's live editorial intake/review queue must be reachable directly from the default landing surface, or via one obvious action — not buried in navigation.

title: SKU review systems must preserve a distinct availability-negative disposition
requirement_summary: Where availability is in scope for a SKU/product Clank's QC model, an availability-negative disposition ('exists, correctly identified, not currently available') must stay distinct from false-positive, duplicate, and not-useful — any queryable encoding satisfies this; a literal OUT_OF_STOCK label is not required.
